def f(x, y, mod=1000000007):
    res = 1
    for i in range(30, -1, -1):
        res = (res * res) % mod
        if (1 << i) & y:
            res = (res * x) % mod
    return res

def main():
    p, k = map(int, input().split())
    vst = [0] * 1000006
    ans = 0
    if k == 1:
        print(f(p, p))
        return
    for i in range(1, p):
        if vst[i] == 0:
            vst[i] = 1
            ans += 1
            cur = (i * k) % p
            while vst[cur] == 0:
                vst[cur] = 1
                cur = (cur * k) % p
    print(f(p, ans))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
